forecasts.raw_text: NE winds around 5 kt, becoming NW this afternoon. Seas less than 2 ft or less. Bay and inland waters smooth. Scattered showers. Scattered tstms late this morning, then isolated tstms late.
NE winds around 5 kt, becoming E after midnight. Seas less than 2 ft or less. Bay and inland waters light chop. Scattered showers.
E winds 5 to 10 kt. Seas less than 2 ft or less. Wave detail: E 1 foot at 2 seconds. Bay and inland waters light chop. Scattered showers and tstms.

E winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 20 kt. Seas 1 to 2 ft, building to 2 to 3 ft after midnight. Wave detail: E 2 ft at 3 seconds. Bay and inland waters light chop. Scattered tstms. Numerous showers early in the evening, then scattered showers in the late evening and overnight.

NE winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 20 kt. Seas 2 to 3 ft. Wave detail: NE 3 ft at 3 seconds. Bay and inland waters light chop. Scattered showers and tstms in the morning. Showers and numerous tstms in the afternoon.
NE winds 20 to 25 kt. Seas 2 to 4 ft, occasionally to 5 ft. Wave detail: NE 4 ft at 4 seconds. Bay and inland waters a moderate chop. Scattered tstms. Showers, mainly in the evening.

E winds 15 to 20 kt, diminishing to 10 to 15 kt in the afternoon. Seas 2 to 4 ft, occasionally to 5 ft. Bay and inland waters a moderate chop. Scattered showers and tstms in the morning, then showers and numerous tstms in the afternoon.
forecasts.wind_commentary: diminishing to 10 to 15 kt in the afternoon

forecasts.raw_text: E winds 10 to 15 kt. Seas around 2 ft. Bay and inland waters light chop. Showers and numerous tstms early in the evening, then showers with a chance of tstms in the late evening and overnight.

E winds 10 to 15 kt, becoming SE 5 to 10 kt in the afternoon. Seas around 2 ft. Bay and inland waters light chop. Showers with a chance of tstms until late afternoon, then showers with tstms likely late.

forecasts.raw_text: E winds 5 to 10 kt. Seas less than 2 ft or less. Bay and inland waters light chop. A chance of tstms. Showers until early morning, then a chance of showers late.winds and seas higher in and near tstms.
